in_urdu.name: سہرا
in_urdu.meaning: رات، سحر، یا سویرے کا وقت

in_hindi.name: सेहरा
in_hindi.meaning: रात, सहर या सोने का समय
in_hindi.long_meaning: सेहरा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है रात या सवेरा। यह नाम रात के समय की शांति और आराम की भावना को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम अपनी सुंदर अर्थों के कारण लोकप्रिय है।

in_pashto.name: سهره
in_pashto.meaning: شپه، سحر، يا د خوب وخت
in_pashto.long_meaning: سهره نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د شپې یا سحر وخت دی. دا نوم د شپې د آرام او سکون یادونه کوي. د پښتنو په دود او کلتور کې دا نوم د ښکلي معنا له امله مشهور دی.

data.cultural_impact: The sighting of the Sehra signifies the beginning of a new lunar month and the start of a new cycle. This is a significant occasion in Islamic culture, marking the beginning of various practices and observances such as the daily recitation of certain prayers and fasting during the Month of Ramadan.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the sighting of the Sehra holds great significance in the Islamic tradition as it marks the beginning of a new cycle of spiritual growth and reflection. Muslims are encouraged to use this new lunar month as an opportunity to turn towards Allah (God) and improve their actions and behavior, striving to be better servants of their Creator. The Sehra serves as a reminder of the continuous cycle of life and the importance of staying mindful and seeking the pleasure of Allah in all aspects of life.
